description: This file provides memory management utilities, including wrappers around malloc, calloc, realloc, and free with error handling. It also includes a handler for failed allocations that logs errors and optionally aborts the process.

methods.name: void handle_failed_alloc(char const * func,size_t size,char const * file,int line,int do_abort)
methods.description: Handles failed memory allocations by logging error details and optionally aborting the process.

methods.name: void * he_bus_malloc_at(size_t size,char const * file,int line,int do_abort)
methods.description: Allocates memory with error handling and reporting.

methods.name: void * he_bus_calloc_at(size_t num,size_t size,char const * file,int line,int do_abort)
methods.description: Allocates zero-initialized memory with error handling and reporting.

methods.name: void * he_bus_realloc_at(void * ptr,size_t new_size,char const * file,int line,int do_abort)
methods.description: Reallocates memory with error handling and reporting.

methods.name: void he_bus_free_at(void * ptr,char const * file,int line,int do_abort)
methods.description: Frees memory; parameters related to error handling are unused in this implementation.
